loss_operation_errors.message: Peer is no longer responding to active session (timed out after 13.6s)

retained_failed_attempts: Initial Windows native suite passed104/107; three UDP tests timed out in wait_event. All three passed by explicit name outside sandbox after AP connection, without source changes. These two environmental changes do not establish exact cause. An intervening --rerun-failed selected different numeric IDs with the wire exclusion, so it is not counted as the UDP retry.

Prototype ACL report fixture initially assumed only Administer callbacks and omitted a trusted CASE fabric resolver. The core also checks View and rejects missing resolver. The corrected test uses both real privilege checks and new_case constructors; production ACL code was unchanged for these fixture corrections.
limitations: Single-run normal C6 measurements are not statistical or specification-wide worst-case bounds; the 100 ms sampler may miss shorter peaks.
One allocation/free and two bounded encoding passes replace resident storage for each encoded read; scalar reads remain allocation-free.
Compiler helper frames add up to 64 bytes on the ACL entry encoder call path. Individual frames/watermarks are not a complete worst-case stack bound; the 12800-byte task reservation is unchanged.
Direct ACL encoding OOM returns ResourceExhausted; existing IM provider-error mappings remain Read path Failure and sole failed initial Subscribe path InvalidAction.
Observer firmware contains 18956 bytes of attribution metadata; whole-system heap comparisons use only normal images.
Final free bytes/largest blocks depend on workload and allocator placement; no elimination of fragmentation is inferred.
No new official CSA, Apple/Google Home pairing, or newly matched ESP-Matter benchmark.
